name: Aero
about: A theme that is always there to pick on the Theme page (see launcher_theme.py and README.txt in this folder): the launcher as a mid-2000s Frutiger Aero desktop: sky, water, grass, bubbles and glossy glass. Its buttons are the pictures in the aero-ui folder and its banners the aero_*__theme-aero pictures (art-src\scripts\aero_buttons.py and aero_banners.py draw them, from art in art-src that no other part of the launcher or the website uses). Lettering in the pictures is Selawik (art-src\fonts, SIL Open Font License); the launcher's own text stays in the usual font (Segoe UI on Windows). "standard": true makes it what players wear when nothing is picked on the Theme page (the user, 2026-11-23); the launcher's own look is then "Classic" there.
